agreement.title: Data Usage Agreement for Renewable Energy Analytic and System Optimization Network (REASON)
agreement.content: The data user (hereinafter referred to as "User") shall carefully read and agree to all terms of this Agreement before using any data products provided by the "Renewable Energy Analytic and System Optimization Network (REASON)" Platform. The User's act of utilizing data obtained directly from this Platform or indirectly acquired through other channels shall be deemed as full understanding and acceptance of all terms herein. If the User objects to any term of this Agreement, the User must immediately cease using the Platform and its data. This Agreement may be revised periodically, with modifications prominently displayed on the relevant Platform pages. If the User does not accept the updated version, the User must discontinue accessing the Platform and using any data, products, or services provided herein. Continued access to the Platform or use of its data following any modifications shall constitute the User's acceptance of the revised Agreement.
agreement.clause1: The Renewable Energy Analytic and System Optimization Network (REASON) Platform provides high-quality renewable energy potential data for wind, solar, hydro, and other resources. The Platform shall not be liable for any legal risks arising from the use of the Platform. Users shall not use data directly or indirectly obtained from the Platform for activities that endanger national security, public interests, or the legitimate rights and interests of others. The Platform assumes no responsibility for any results or statements derived from the data by Users.
agreement.clause2: The data provided by the Platform may contain inherent errors or uncertainties due to factors such as original data sources, model algorithms, parameterization schemes, calculation conditions, and changes in the natural environment. Users shall fully understand the limitations of the data and independently assess its applicability. The Platform shall not be liable for any direct or indirect consequences resulting from the use of the data.
agreement.clause3: We attach great importance to user privacy and security, and will take reasonable security measures to protect users' personal information. However, due to the inherent nature of the Internet, absolute data security cannot be guaranteed. Therefore, users should handle their personal information with caution when using the platform.
agreement.clause4: In the event of any technical issues with the Platform, we will repair them as soon as possible. However, we shall not be liable for any losses incurred thereby.
agreement.clause5: When using the data from this platform in conference reports, paper publications, or other forms, (1) users are required to acknowledge "Renewable Energy Analytic and System Optimization Network (REASON)"; (2) when publishing papers, they must cite the relevant research of the data providers. For specific citations, please refer to the relevant data instructions.
agreement.clause6: The data provided by this platform is limited to non-commercial use. Without the prior written authorization of the "Renewable Energy Analytic and System Optimization Network (REASON)" platform, no entity or individual shall use the data for commercial purposes. Any use of the platform's data by commercial organizations shall be deemed as commercial use and shall require prior written authorization from the platform team. For applications to use the platform's data for commercial purposes or applications by commercial organizations to use the platform's data, please contact us via the organizational E-mail: xuchun{'@'}tsinghua.edu.cn.
agreement.clause7: The Platform's data shall not be used for judicial purposes, and the platform shall not be liable for any consequences arising therefrom.
agreement.clause8: The Users warrant that they will only use the data materials authorized by the platform for their own research, and shall not transfer the platform's data and website accounts to third parties, whether for consideration or free of charge. Users shall bear their own responsibilities for any violations of this requirement. The platform team reserves the right to pursue legal liability against the aforementioned offenders.
agreement.clause9: The User shall ensure the integrity and independence of data during the process of using it. Without the written authorization of the platform team, no user may use the data obtained from the platform, whether in its original form or modified form, in other data products or models. For users who violate this agreement, the platform has the right to demand that they stop using and storing the data at any time, and is entitled to pursue legal actions for any form of damage caused thereby.
agreement.clause10: The right to interpret, modify and update this agreement belongs to the platform team. The platform's data products will be updated regularly. Registered users are requested to download directly from the platform to obtain the latest version information. Users shall properly keep their own accounts, passwords and other registration information. If any account theft or other security issues are found, please contact the platform staff immediately for handling. The platform shall not be liable for any losses caused by account and password leakage, loss or other security issues due to the user's own reasons.

background.title: Platform Background
background.content1: Climate change and energy security are prominent global challenges at present. Actively developing clean energy and promoting green and low-carbon transformation of the economy and society have become a universal consensus of the international community to address global climate change. China has proposed a new energy security strategy of "four revolutions and one cooperation", and under the guidance of the "dual carbon" goal, it provides fundamental guidance for the high-quality development of clean energy in the new era. Clean energy, such as wind power, solar power, and hydropower, is considered an important component of the future energy system due to its clean, renewable, and environmentally friendly characteristics. However, the development and utilization of clean energy face multiple challenges, including uneven distribution of resource potential, diverse resource characteristics, and multiple constraints such as technological maturity, economic feasibility, ecological environment protection, and policy guidance.
background.content2: To scientifically, systematically, and comprehensively evaluate the potential for global clean energy development, promote the green and low-carbon transformation of energy structure, and promote sustainable energy development, SpatioTemporal Analytics for Renewable-energy Synergy (REASON Platform) has emerged. This platform aims to focus on and respond promptly to the hot concerns of the international community in the field of renewable energy and other areas. Through high-precision, multi temporal and spatial scale data intelligent analysis technology, we provide comprehensive, accurate, and timely non-commercial data on the potential and current status of clean energy resource development for universities, research institutions, government agencies, and the energy industry. This provides scientific basis for energy planning, policy formulation, investment decision-making, and helps accelerate the transformation of the global and Chinese energy systems towards a cleaner, low-carbon, and more efficient direction. At the same time, this platform helps to enhance China's competitiveness and influence in the global clean energy field, contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to building a community with a shared future for mankind.

features.title: Platform Features
features.content2: for multi-source heterogeneous data fusion methods, building hourly kilometer-level high-precision assimilation database with hourly and kilometer-level accuracy, integrate dynamic calculation models of clean energy generation resources such as wind, solar and hydropower by fusing machine learning and deep learning of all technical types, and construct multi-temporal and multi-spatial resource maps covering hourly to climate scales.
features.content4: , supporting clean energy distribution heat maps from 1km grid to global scale,carrying out multi-scale resource output characteristic analysis in multiple time dimensions, with a focus on achieving refined representation at the county level in China.
features.content5: The platform tracks hot issues of renewable energy in the international community in real-time, providing data-driven intelligent decision support for energy planning and policy making.

team.title: Platform Team
team.intro: REASON Platform is jointly developed and maintained by the Institute of Carbon Neutrality at Tsinghua University, School of Environment at Tsinghua University, and Mita Carbon (Hangzhou) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

thanks.title: Acknowledgments
thanks.content: The REASON Platform would like to thank Mita Carbon (Hangzhou) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. for its support. It has also received backing from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (including Youth Science Fund Project [Category A] and Key Program Projects), the National Key R&D Program of China, the Energy Foundation China, the Science and Technology Program of Yunnan Province, and the Project of Tsinghua-Dongfang Electric Joint Research Institute for Future Energy and Equipment, among other initiatives.
